title: Supporter Hall of Fame — public display names
description: Separate launcher-only list in source order. Empty names is a valid replacement. Publication also rejects leading/trailing whitespace, Unicode Cc/Cf/Cs characters, canonically equivalent duplicate names, and files over 128000 UTF-8 bytes. No account, payment, tier or amount fields.

items.description: Public display name. Publication uses an 80 Unicode code-point limit, conservatively within the launcher's 80 Swift Character limit.
